CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS student_onboarding_draft (
    student_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    schema_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL
        CHECK (schema_version = 'student-onboarding-draft.v1'),
    status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('DRAFT','COMPLETED')),
    direction_code VARCHAR(64),
    self_assessed_experience VARCHAR(64),
    known_stacks TEXT[],
    desired_stacks TEXT[],
    goal_code VARCHAR(64),
    goal_text VARCHAR(500),
    preferred_language VARCHAR(16),
    weekly_minutes INTEGER,
    preferred_pace VARCHAR(64),
    version BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (version >= 1),
    completed_profile_version BIGINT,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    CONSTRAINT ck_student_onboarding_draft_codes CHECK (
        (direction_code IS NULL OR char_length(btrim(direction_code)) BETWEEN 1 AND 64)
        AND (self_assessed_experience IS NULL OR char_length(btrim(self_assessed_experience)) BETWEEN 1 AND 64)
        AND (goal_code IS NULL OR char_length(btrim(goal_code)) BETWEEN 1 AND 64)
        AND (preferred_pace IS NULL OR char_length(btrim(preferred_pace)) BETWEEN 1 AND 64)
    ),
    CONSTRAINT ck_student_onboarding_draft_language CHECK (
        preferred_language IS NULL OR char_length(btrim(preferred_language)) BETWEEN 2 AND 16
    ),
    CONSTRAINT ck_student_onboarding_draft_weekly_minutes CHECK (
        weekly_minutes IS NULL OR weekly_minutes BETWEEN 15 AND 10080
    ),
    CONSTRAINT ck_student_onboarding_draft_known_stacks CHECK (
        known_stacks IS NULL OR cardinality(known_stacks) <= 20
    ),
    CONSTRAINT ck_student_onboarding_draft_desired_stacks CHECK (
        desired_stacks IS NULL OR cardinality(desired_stacks) BETWEEN 1 AND 20
    ),
    CONSTRAINT ck_student_onboarding_draft_time CHECK (
        updated_at >= created_at
        AND (completed_at IS NULL OR (completed_at >= created_at AND completed_at <= updated_at))
    ),
    CONSTRAINT ck_student_onboarding_draft_completion CHECK (
        (
            status = 'DRAFT'
            AND completed_profile_version IS NULL
            AND completed_at IS NULL
        )
        OR (
            status = 'COMPLETED'
            AND direction_code IS NULL
            AND self_assessed_experience IS NULL
            AND known_stacks IS NULL
            AND desired_stacks IS NULL
            AND goal_code IS NULL
            AND goal_text IS NULL
            AND preferred_language IS NULL
            AND weekly_minutes IS NULL
            AND preferred_pace IS NULL
            AND completed_profile_version >= 1
            AND completed_at IS NOT NULL
        )
    )
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS student_onboarding_draft_command (
    request_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    student_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES student_onboarding_draft(student_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    command_kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL CHECK (command_kind IN ('REPLACE','FINALIZE')),
    request_hash CHAR(64) NOT NULL CHECK (request_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
    result_draft_version BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (result_draft_version >= 1),
    result_profile_version BIGINT,
    response_json JSONB NOT NULL CHECK (jsonb_typeof(response_json) = 'object'),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT ck_student_onboarding_draft_command_result CHECK (
        (command_kind = 'REPLACE' AND result_profile_version IS NULL)
        OR (command_kind = 'FINALIZE' AND result_profile_version >= 1)
    )
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_student_onboarding_draft_command_student
    ON student_onboarding_draft_command (student_id, created_at DESC);
